title: Solar power expression
description: Essential: Correctly states the solar power received by the bright side as P = π σ T_s⁴ (R² R_s² / R₀²).

title: Wind power expression
description: Essential: Correctly expresses wind power in terms of P and x as P_w = [x³(1-x)/(1+x³)] P.

title: Maximum wind power estimate
description: Essential: Provides a numerical estimate for the maximum of P_w/P to one significant figure (e.g., 0.08).

title: Energy balance setup
description: Important: Applies energy conservation to relate received solar power P, wind power P_w, and radiated powers from both sides.

title: Reversible engine condition
description: Important: Uses the condition Q₁/T₁ = Q₂/T₂ for the heat transfers driving the atmospheric heat engine.

title: Algebraic derivation
description: Important: Shows correct algebraic manipulation to derive the expression for P_w in terms of P and x.

title: Optimization reasoning
description: Optional: Briefly explains the method (e.g., derivative, numerical) to find the maximum of the function in x.

title: Incorrect area factor
description: Pitfall: Uses the planet's full surface area (4πR²) instead of the projected area (πR²) for received solar power.

title: Sign or definition error
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets heat flows (Q₁, Q₂) or writes an energy balance that violates conservation.

title: Unit or constant omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to include necessary constants (σ, π) in final expressions for P or P_w.
